name: balanced
description: Default Screen Guardian preset. Intended mapping on synthetic_moving_regions: first-pass ~0.64 is MID (band [0.50, 0.66)) so the agent may REINSPECT, then BLUR. High (>=0.66) skips reinspect and BLURs. Low (<0.50) is NO_ACTION. block_trigger 0.97 sits above typical reinspect ~0.92 so Balanced does not collapse onto Strict OPAQUE_MASK.
